summary: Extends the MRT format for exporting BGP routing data so it can carry optional geographic coordinates. The coordinates can describe where a BGP collector is, and where each of its BGP peers is. This helps researchers relate routing data to physical places.

eli5.summary: Imagine a list of mail carriers with a dot on a map for each one. This adds the map dots to the files that record how internet routers talk, so you know where each router lives.

questions: how to add location to bgp data
